gold: Stage IIIC (T4aN3) melanoma with satellite metastases

selector.rationale: The patient's history of a left posterior auricular scalp lesion, incidentally resected lymph node with focal involvement, and development of multiple satellite lesions are all consistent with melanoma. The histopathology and immunostaining results also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Drug-induced inflammation
rejected.why: While the patient is undergoing immunotherapy, the primary issue is the progression of melanoma lesions, not just an inflammatory reaction.

rejected.label: Immune-mediated reaction
rejected.why: This is a possible component of the patient's response to immunotherapy, but it does not explain the underlying disease process as well as melanoma does.
